clue.text: Putting archbishop in hell gets a cheer

indicators.note: putting one thing in another means the archbishop goes inside the word for hell

parts.note: the pit is a traditional name for hell
William Laud was Archbishop of Canterbury under Charles I

explanation.surface: Sending a hated churchman to hell earns applause from the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: William Laud, Charles I's Archbishop of Canterbury, was executed in 1645, which gives the surface its edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaudit is an expression of praise or applause, just as a cheer is.

clue.text: Caller holding forward one person less powerful than he looks

definitions.text: person less powerful than he looks

indicators.note: something holding another contains it, so the caller wraps round the next pieces

parts.note: a pager is a device that calls or bleeps you
pert means cheeky or forward
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A telephone caller brushes aside a forward person who seems feebler than he pretends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Caller' looks like someone on the telephone, but it is a bleeping device.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a threat or bully that looks fearsome but is in fact weak and ineffectual.

clue.text: An elected church, very positive at heart, makes a contribution to fish sauce

indicators.note: at heart means placed in the middle, so very and positive sit inside the word for elected

parts.note: chosen means elected or picked
yes is a positive reply
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Somehow a church election ends up in a recipe for a fishy condiment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at heart' reads like part of 'very positive at heart', but it is the container signal for the word meaning elected.
explanation.definitionFit: The salty paste or extract of small cured fish is a traditional ingredient in fish sauces and relishes.

clue.text: See 8
I'm he — teach cocks and hens to hover: me too, sadly wishing they could to avoid this 27

definitions.text: wishing they could to avoid this 27

indicators.note: sadly suggests things going wrong, so the letters of the words before it are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, apostrophe dropped
taken as written
taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A farmer wishes his poultry could fly off and escape the grim fate awaiting them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a joining word left out of the anagram. The 27 refers to TRAGEDY: the proverb says misdeeds return to haunt their author, and the birds, flying home at dusk, wish they could hover instead.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says bad deeds rebound on the doer, which is the comeuppance birds who could hover might escape.

clue.text: Gulf state heard to have nasal problem

indicators.note: heard tells us to go by how the name of the Gulf state is pronounced

parts.note: Qatar is a state on the Persian Gulf

explanation.surface: A Gulf state is reported to be suffering from a blocked nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflammation causing a build-up of mucus in the nose and throat is a classic nasal complaint.

clue.text: See 4
Reproduce sound from end of race that was fastest ever

parts.note: the tape is stretched across the finishing line of a race
a record is the best time ever achieved

explanation.surface: Athletics commentators replay the roar from a record-breaking finish.
explanation.definitionFit: To capture sounds on magnetic tape for playback is to reproduce them mechanically.

clue.text: Extension for French boy with backing of law

parts.note: René is a common French boy's name

indicators.note: backing means read in reverse, so the word law is turned round

explanation.surface: A French lad secures more time thanks to legal support.
explanation.definitionFit: A renewal of a lease or licence extends it for a further period.

clue.text: Happy time making clay in Japanese car, say the wise

indicators.note: in places the reworked letters of clay within the car maker

parts.note: Honda is a Japanese car maker

indicators.note: making clay into something means its letters are reshaped
say tells us the following word is to be taken by its sound, here two letters with a possessive

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like YS

explanation.surface: Sages say happy days came from moulding clay inside a Japanese car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' rearranges clay to ALCY. 'say' signals a sound-alike: the plural of the letter Y sounds like 'wise'; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Halcyon days are a past period of calm happiness and prosperity, recalled fondly.

clue.text: Big beast suffering cramp when digesting Clarendon

indicators.note: digesting means taking something inside, so the reworked letters swallow the next piece
suffering suggests something being twisted, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: Edward Hyde was the first Earl of Clarendon, the 17th-century statesman

explanation.surface: A large animal gets cramp after eating something heavy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering' rearranges cramp to PACRM, which then does the 'digesting'. Clarendon is the title, not a name to use as it stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Elephants, rhinos and hippos are thick-skinned large mammals, the group this term covers.

clue.text: Glass left to experts, perhaps

parts.note: a pane is a sheet of glass in a window

explanation.surface: Glazing decisions are left to the professionals.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of specialists convened to judge or advise is one kind of panel, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: See 18
Metalled road for when things get tough?

definitions.meaning: a road with a hard surface of stones or tarmac, read literally
the idiom for learning or doing something through difficulty and struggle

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means by painful experience, and read literally describes a firmly surfaced route.

clue.text: 9 caught between money and love

indicators.note: between places the catch abbreviation in the gap separating the two words around it

parts.note: rhino is old British slang for money
Eros is the Greek god of love
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Someone is trapped in a dilemma between wealth and romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The cross-reference to 9 points to a pachyderm, and this horned beast is a classic thick-skinned giant.

clue.text: Fabulous setter's endlessly stupid

parts.note: the setter speaking of himself, his things are mine, so my

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word for stupid is dropped

parts.note: thick means stupid

explanation.surface: The compiler admits, self-mockingly, that he is wonderfully dim.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabulous in its old sense means belonging to fable or legend, which is the sense here.

clue.text: Town making lace for church in Milne's version

indicators.note: in puts the church abbreviation inside the reworked name
a version of a name is that name rendered differently, so the author's letters are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A. A. Milne writes a telling of a lacemaking town's story with a church in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'version' rearranges the author's name to MELIN, which holds the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Mechlin, now Mechelen in Belgium, gave its name to the fine bobbin lace produced there.

clue.text: See 2
14 matricide picked by the Sun

parts.note: elect means picked or chosen
Ra was the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: A newspaper picks out a mother-killer for its front page.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 is MYTHIC, so the definition is a mythic matricide.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth she urged her brother Orestes to kill their mother Clytemnestra.

clue.text: The trick is to say "aspersion"

indicators.note: to say means the word for an aspersion is to be pronounced, not spelt

parts.note: a slight is a disparaging remark or insult

explanation.surface: Someone claims the trick to it is simply to cast slurs.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight of hand is dexterous trickery, and sleight alone means cunning or a deceptive trick.

clue.text: Are audiences held in the loo?

definitions.text: Are audiences held in the loo?

parts.words: Are audiences held in the loo?
parts.note: a monarch grants audiences in a formal state chamber; the seat is also slang for a lavatory, hence the joke

explanation.definitionFit: A state chamber containing a monarch's seat is where royal audiences are formally granted.

clue.text: Clue not used by aviator?

indicators.note: used means worked over, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pilot has no need of a crossword hint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aviator' is a flier, not a pilot: here a flying mammal, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The noctule is a large European bat, a creature that flies, so whimsically an aviator.

clue.text: Use cutters without hesitation as muscle trainers

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the cutters surround the hesitation

parts.note: excisers are people or things that cut out
er is a hesitant noise

explanation.surface: An instruction to use clippers decisively when making gym equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside, its old sense, not lacking. 'Use' and 'as' only link the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Exercisers are devices such as chest expanders used to build and tone muscles.

clue.text: Half a purple flower unpopular with union

indicators.note: half takes the first four of the eight letters of the flower's name

parts.note: scabious is a wild flower with mauve or purple pincushion heads

explanation.surface: A trade union frowns on a half-grown purple bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A strikebreaker who keeps working during industrial action is despised by trade unionists.

clue.text: Mad as a 19

definitions.meaning: 19 is NOCTULE, a bat, so like a bat

explanation.definitionFit: Batty is slang for crazy, and literally means bat-like, matching the flying mammal at 19.

clue.text: Constellation with daemon

definitions.meaning: a northern group of stars containing Vega
the heroine of Philip Pullman's His Dark Materials novels, accompanied by her animal soul companion

explanation.definitionFit: The Lyre is a northern star group, and Pullman's heroine Belacqua has the daemon Pantalaimon.

clue.text: See 1 down
Any Scots interrupting a haggard counsellor?

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into, so the Scots word goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: gaunt means haggard and drawn
ony is the Scots form of any

explanation.surface: A careworn adviser is visited by some Scotsmen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interrupting' breaks into the letters after their second one; ony is the Scots word for any.
explanation.definitionFit: An agony aunt is a magazine columnist who counsels readers about their personal problems.

clue.text: Performer's heart is tender and it shows

indicators.note: it shows means the letters are on display within the three words before it

explanation.surface: An actor's kindly nature is plain for all to see.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', a link to the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: An artiste is a professional entertainer such as a singer or dancer.

clue.text: Ancient in shot at Hamlet, perhaps

indicators.note: in places the word for ancient within the word for a shot

parts.note: a try is an attempt or shot
aged means old or ancient

explanation.surface: An old marksman takes a pot at a small village.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hamlet' looks like a little village to be shot at; it is Shakespeare's play.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet is one of Shakespeare's great tragedies, an example of the dramatic genre.
